messages:
Claire: dropped a new mock for the version-history view — trying a timecode-first grid for canaries. snapshot thumbnails on the left, timeline scrub on the right. screenshots -> https://img.redwood.test/mocks/vh-grid.png Diego: nice — quick note: keyboard traversal is weird in the grid. tab goes into the thumbnail, then skips to the scrub instead of going to the next thumbnail. I think we need a predictable tabindex order (row-major) + explicit aria-row/aria-col. Julia: microcopy: the CTA under each snapshot currently says 'Rollback'. Suggest 'Revert to this version' (longer but clearer for non-devs). Also on mobile the CTA truncates to 'Revert…' with no tooltip — that's going to confuse PMs. Harry: density question: with 6 tiny thumbnails the visual details are lost. For accessibility we should either increase size or fall back to a stacked list for screen readers so the descriptive text is first. Otherwise a screen reader will just read "image" x6. Diego: quick aria proposal (pseudo): ```html
``` Diego: also recommend aria-live=\"polite\" on the preview region when you switch snapshots so screen readers announce the selected state. Claire: good call. a11y-bot, any automated flags on the mock? a11y-bot: automated scan results: 3 issues found — images missing descriptive alt text (WCAG 1.1.1), grid lacks role and row/col attributes (WCAG 4.1.2), interactive elements have inconsistent focus styles (WCAG 2.4.7). Links: https://a11y.redwood/reports/1719999999 Julia: plus one on keyboard focus visible — need 3px high-contrast outline (not box-shadow-only). Also the color for the selected thumbnail is green currently; fails contrast against selection border in dark mode. Harry: UX suggestion: keep the timecode above the thumbnail (compact) and show metadata on hover/focus (variant name, % traffic, commit). For small widths collapse to a vertical list: thumbnail left, metadata right — easier for touch. Claire: decision needed for this sprint: do we (A) implement grid with aria roles + larger thumbnails, (B) stack list on mobile-only, or (C) revert to single-column timeline like current? My vote: A + B (grid desktop, stacked mobile) with the microcopy change Julia suggested. Diego: I can prototype the grid keyboard order and aria attributes by EOD. Will include the aria-live behavior and focus styles. Julia: I'll update copy strings and add tooltip behavior for truncated CTAs. Acceptance criteria: 1) screenreader reads: 'Snapshot , variant , traffic <%>, button Revert to this version' in that order; 2) keyboard tab order follows visual order; 3) selection announced via aria-live. Claire: thanks — if we agree on A+B I'll mark this design ticket ready for handoff. :white_check_mark: Harry: tiny nit — change the offline snapshot icon to not rely on color (add dotted outline) so it’s distinguishable in greyscale prints. Diego: noted. I'll push the PR with prototypes and screenshots into #design-handoff and ping the eng-reviewers. Claire: perfect — linking the mock in the ticket and tagging @product for visibility.
